name: WelfordUpdate
note: adv_api normalization Welford online step (complements welfordfinalize). WelfordUpdate<T,U>(outMean,outVar,inMean,inVar,inputX,WelfordUpdateParam{rnLength,abLength,abComputeLength,nRec}). float path: outMean=inMean+nRec*(x-inMean); outVar=inVar+(x-inMean)*(x-outMean). U is always float.
